name: sdlc
description: End-to-end issue orchestration: the /sdlc:orchestrate-ready grooming skill, the /sdlc:orchestrate flow, the /sdlc:orchestrate-cleanup pass that removes the worktrees, local branches and scratch a merged or closed PR left behind, or the whole repo's after one go-ahead, and its review state only under --review-state, and the /sdlc:orchestrate-analysis time report, configured through three tiers written by /sdlc:sdlc-config-global, /sdlc:sdlc-config-repo and /sdlc:sdlc-config-user, plus the issue-developer, issue-fixer, code-documenter, style-checker, docs-writer, agent-memory-scrubber, pr-merge-readiness, pr-finalizer, and pr-monitor agents, and a theorem-based PR review pipeline run by the theorem-based-pr-reviewer agent and built from a theorem-generator spawned at a per-round effort tier, a theorem-assessor that assesses every theorem list the generator emits, parallel theorem-disprovers, and parallel counterexample-verifiers, plus the reload-after-compact hook that appends the full text of the skills and rule files a conversation loaded to it after a compaction, in place of any reload message the compacted conversation already holds, and the orchestrate-status hook that pins an /sdlc:orchestrate run's issues, PR, phase, round and running agents under the prompt, which /orchestrate-status turns off and on.
